title: tool-calling: improve execution ergonomics for multi-tool & parallel calls, result injection and retries
author: Aisha Malik
description:
Motivation: Tool-calling is widely used in multi-tool scenarios (search + calculator + db) and we observed several production pain points: (1) poor ergonomics for parallel tool invocation, (2) inconsistent injection of tool results into subsequent model prompts, (3) brittle retries that either duplicate effects or lose context, and (4) gaps in the OpenAI-compat layer for streaming + function-call interop.

Summary: This PR implements an end-to-end ergonomics improvement for tool execution: a unified execution plan that supports multi-tool dispatch (serial and parallel), deterministic result injection back into the model's context, idempotent retry semantics with at-least-once protection for side-effecting tools, and updates to the OpenAI compatibility shim to maintain streaming stability when function/tool calls are involved. Changes touch runtime executor, tool manager, SDK compatibility shims, docs, and integration tests.

Key changes: - Execution plan abstraction (Executor.execute_plan) which stages tool calls and their metadata; supports parallel groups and ordered groups. - Tool result envelopes: standardized JSON envelope for tool outputs with metadata (source tool, call_id, timestamp, error flags) used for deterministic injection into prompts. - Retry coordinator: central coordinator that tracks call_id and retry_state to avoid double-apply for registered side-effecting tools and to provide retry-safe cached responses for idempotent tools. - Streaming integration: updated OpenAI-compat streaming adapter to buffer and interleave function-call events so clients receive stable partial responses during long-running tool calls. - SDK changes (python + typescript shims) to expose new call options: injection_mode (append|replace|annotate), parallel_group boolean, retry_policy. - Tests & docs: new integration tests covering multi-tool parallel calls, incremental streaming during tool execution, and migration notes in the API docs.

Backwards compatibility: Default behavior preserves previous single-tool function-calling semantics. New options are opt-in. OpenAI-compat layer preserves the previous streaming event order for non-tool calls; for tool-involving streams we now emit explicit function_call.start/complete events to make behavior deterministic.

Testing: Unit tests added for executor scheduling, retry coordinator, and envelope parsing. Integration tests added that run a simulated search+calc+db pipeline in parallel and verify deterministic prompt injection and correct final model input. Manual canary on staging with real traffic for two days (no regressions). CI: unit & integration passes; lint fixes included.

Checklist: - [x] Design + spec (ENG-4312) - [x] Runtime implementation - executor, tool_manager - [x] OpenAI compatibility updates - [x] SDK shims (python, ts) - [x] Tests (unit + integration) - [x] Docs and migration notes

Release notes: Adds improved tool-calling ergonomics: parallel tool groups, deterministic tool-result injection, configurable retry policies to avoid duplicate side-effects, and streaming stability improvements for function/tool combos. Opt-in via new call options; no breaking changes by default.

diff_snippets:
+ def execute_plan(self, plan):
+     # plan contains groups: serial or parallel
+     for group in plan.groups:
+         if group.parallel:
+             self._dispatch_parallel(group)
         else:
             self._dispatch_serial(group)

+ class ToolResultEnvelope:
+     def __init__(self, tool, call_id, payload, ts, error=False):
+         self.tool = tool
+         self.call_id = call_id
+         self.payload = payload
+         self.ts = ts
+         self.error = error

+ # openai compat: emit explicit markers for long-running tool calls
+ yield {"type": "function_call.start", "name": tool.name, "call_id": call_id}

release_notes: Improved tool-calling ergonomics: parallel tool groups, deterministic tool-result injection, configurable retry policies to reduce duplicate side-effects, and more stable streaming behavior for function/tool interactions. Opt-in via new call options (injection_mode, parallel_group, retry_policy).
notes_for_ops: Staging canary completed (2 days). Needs rollout window for Dedicated customers; recommend feature flag default off for first 2 weeks in prod. Monitor tool-call error rate and duplicate side-effect alerts.
migration_guide: New SDK options: injection_mode (append|replace|annotate) toggles how tool output is injected into prompts. parallel_group boolean enables parallel dispatch. retry_policy supports (none|idempotent_cached|coordinator_safe). Old calls continue to behave the same; update SDK to pick up convenience helpers.
